findings.reason: the rg is the only thing pinning the removal of the duplicated CodeFile→HAS_CHUNK traversal, and as written it cannot see two of the five sites the change exists to fix, so the dead join can remain in server.py and schema_context.py undetected.
findings.text: §19 says all five readers embed the new fragment and that "a test pins the rendered join and expression" with done-when `rg 'CODE_EXAMPLE_ID|coalesce\(.*source_file' imas_codex`, but two of the five declared sites do not contain either token: `imas_codex/llm/server.py:827` is `OPTIONAL MATCH (sf:CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node) … sf.path AS source_file` and `imas_codex/graph/schema_context.py:95` is `MATCH (cf:CodeFile)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(node)`, so neither a wrong traversal is removed nor a prior-art duplicate detected by the named guard — the fragment owner (new function in imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py) covers them only if the guard is widened to the `CodeFile)-\[:HAS_CHUNK\]` form

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19's one fragment-renderer in `imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py` hides the `OPTIONAL MATCH … HAS_CHUNK` traversal and the `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` expression behind a single call parameterised by chunk alias and output name, collapsing five divergent resolutions into one; §14 adds no module, extending two existing owners.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan declares the dead `CodeFile-[:HAS_CHUNK]` arm dead and to be removed from all five readers, but two of the five named sites carry neither `CODE_EXAMPLE_ID` nor `coalesce(source_file)`, so the plan's own done-when rg is blind to them and the duplicate traversal survives while the guard reads clean.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied figures public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §14 reuses the existing `--root` CLI option and adds no CLI/MCP/refusal surface, and §19 adds one helper to `imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py` while naming the dead `CODE_EXAMPLE_ID` and `CodeFile-[:HAS_CHUNK]` arms it retires, so its added surface is accounted for in its own text.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 extends the existing `--root` branch of `discover paths` (`imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:258` → `seed_facility_roots(..., root_paths=...)`), the seed's own upsert, and `PATH_RESET_SPECS` (`imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240`) rather than adding a re-expansion path, and names the exclusion record (`persist_scan_results`, `frontier.py:1816`) it reads first; §19 ratifies `imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py` (read-side `HAS_CHUNK` Cypher at graph.py:185–263) and the single edge writer in `imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:517` (MERGE `(e)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c)`), both of which I opened and confirmed.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — neither section adds a wrapper over working machinery: §19 replaces five divergent query fragments with one shared owner (the diverge justifies the consolidation), and §14 extends the seed/reset owners in place rather than layering over them.
